intent: Technical Brief: Asus ProArt Studiobook Pro - System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) issues
suggested_solution: Ensure that all drivers and BIOS are up-to-date for optimal performance.
Verify that the GPU is set to Optix mode in Blender settings.
Consider updating the system's cooling system or adjusting fan settings to prevent thermal throttling.
